sentences.text: The Queen Elizabeth Centre reported on 2025–26, with a role in helping families and communities through early parenting support.
The centre reported that 2,387 families used its services during the year.
sentences.section: Board Chair and Chief Executive Officer Report

sentences.text: It reported the opening of its Hastings early parenting centre in May 2026, with overnight services planned for later that year.
sentences.section: Board Chair and Chief Executive Officer Report

sentences.text: The centre reported that its board and Tweddle’s board recommended a voluntary merger in June 2026, with the proposal awaiting government consideration.
sentences.section: Board Chair and Chief Executive Officer Report

sentences.text: The centre reported average monthly staffing of 106.93 full-time equivalents for 2026.

items.quote: Having considered all available evidence, both Boards concluded that a merger would deliver lasting benefits for children, families and carers, the early parenting workforce and the broader Victorian community.
